purpose: Teach: 増田/古田/川上/水野/古川/桜井/平田/西田

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者増田様のご症状を医療チームで継続観察します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue to monitor patient Masuda's condition as a medical team.
lines.style: Even, professional opener. Measured pace. Slight pause before the patient name — deference to their case. Clear but not distant.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医師古田先生のご助言を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we respect Dr. Furuta's advice within our medical team approach.
lines.style: Steady tone, no change in pitch. The word 'respect' lands with quiet weight. Brief, deliberate. Not a question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、看護師川上様のご経験を医療チームで活かします
lines.en: Ren, we'll draw on Nurse Kawagami's experience as part of our team.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment beneath professionalism. Slight softening on 'experience' — a nod to trust. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬剤師水野先生と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, we're coordinating with Pharmacist Mizuno and the rest of the team.
lines.style: Inclusive tone. Small pause before 'the rest' — framing the collaboration. Clear but conversational, not clinical.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、検査技師古川様のご報告を医療チームで確認します
lines.en: Ren, we'll review the lab tech Furukawa's report as a team.
lines.style: Factual but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'review' — diligence without fuss. Steady eye-contact level delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、リハビリ士桜井様のプログラムを医療チームで採用します
lines.en: Ren, we're adopting Rehabilitation Specialist Sakurai's program as part of our care plan.
lines.style: Affirmative tone. Small lift at 'adopting' — this is a decision made, not a suggestion. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、栄養士平田様のご提案を医療チームで取り入れます
lines.en: Ren, we're incorporating Nutritionist Hirata's recommendations into our approach.
lines.style: Practical, straightforward. Even pacing. Slight warmth on 'incorporating' — teamwork without fanfare.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、心理士西田先生に医療チームで継続ご相談します
lines.en: Ren, we'll continue consulting with Psychologist Nishida as a team moving forward.
lines.style: Closing statement. Slight softening at the end — this is ongoing care, not temporary. Warm closure with professional composure intact.
